bundle.shortDescription: Identify the birds of India to species, with probabilities, photos and records
bundle.longDescription: Version 3 (2026): identify 1,326 bird species of India from what you see, with visible probabilities, best next question, place and month as an optional backup, credited photos, eBird/Clements 2025 names, records by state and month, comparison and search. Works offline.
